meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 将能把网页应用部署到 Vercel。它会自动安装 Vercel 命令行工具，并配置好访问 Vercel 的登录凭证，之后可执行部署、查看部署列表、验证身份等操作。
howto.when: 当用户要求将网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 的生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会运行部署命令并反馈结果。

say.text: 列出我在 Vercel 上的所有部署。
say.note: Claude 会调用 vercel ls 展示列表。

say.text: 检查当前 Vercel 登录状态。
say.note: Claude 会执行 vercel whoami 验证凭证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains the ability to deploy web applications to Vercel. It automatically installs the Vercel CLI and configures credential injection, enabling actions like production deployment, listing deployments, and verifying login status.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude runs the deployment command and reports the result.

say_en.text: List all my deployments on Vercel.
say_en.note: Claude uses vercel ls to show the list.

say_en.text: Check the current Vercel login status.
say_en.note: Claude executes vercel whoami to verify credentials.
